definitions.explanation: completely ending a relationship, usually with family or close associates
preventing the passage of electricity or heat

examples.japanese: {親|おや}と{絶縁|ぜつえん}した。
examples.english: I cut ties with my parents.

examples.japanese: {絶縁状態|ぜつえんじょうたい}が{何年|なんねん}も{続|つづ}いている。
{喧嘩|けんか}をして{兄弟|きょうだい}と{絶縁|ぜつえん}することになった。
examples.english: We had a fight and I ended up cutting ties with my siblings.

examples.japanese: {電線|でんせん}の{絶縁|ぜつえん}が{劣化|れっか}している。
examples.english: The insulation on the electrical wire has deteriorated.

examples.japanese: {絶縁|ぜつえん}テープで{配線|はいせん}を{保護|ほご}する。
examples.english: Protect the wiring with electrical tape.

examples.japanese: この{素材|そざい}は{熱|ねつ}{絶縁性|ぜつえんせい}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This material has high thermal insulation.

notes:
FORMATION:
{絶|ぜつ} (sever, cut off) + {縁|えん} (connection, relationship) → cut connection

VERB FORM:
{絶縁|ぜつえん}する (to cut ties, to insulate)

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {絶縁体|ぜつえんたい} (insulator)
- {絶縁|ぜつえん}テープ (electrical tape)
- {絶縁状態|ぜつえんじょうたい} (state of estrangement)

RELATED WORDS:
- {疎遠|そえん} (estranged - less severe)
- {縁|えん}を{切|き}る (to cut ties)
- {断絶|だんぜつ} (severance, rupture)

DISTINCTION:
{疎遠|そえん} implies drifting apart gradually, while {絶縁|ぜつえん} implies a deliberate, complete severing of the relationship.
